## Description

Scoring on EID/ABHA, phone, DOB and name with transliteration variants; high-confidence pairs merged in bulk (reversible); borderline pairs queued for the receptionist to confirm when the patient is at the desk. Merges audited and undoable.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Scoring identifies seeded Arabic–English variant duplicates with documented precision/recall on the synthetic set.
- [ ] **AC2.** Bulk merges are reversible individually and in batch.
- [ ] **AC3.** Borderline pairs appear as a desk prompt on check-in for that patient.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
